node: Sub-100nm barium titanate and dielectric powders for high-end MLCCs
summary: US-listed exposure to the dielectric-powder chokepoint is mostly indirect because the strongest pure-play powder suppliers identified in the node hypothesis are Japanese or Chinese local listings rather than primary US listings. The usable US-listed universe is therefore a two-lane map: reference MLCC leaders with direct dependence on advanced BaTiO3 capabilities, plus underfollowed/smaller passive-component makers whose hidden signal would be margin/order leverage from high-end MLCC tightness or supplier dependence on merchant dielectric powders. No candidate here is a buy/sell recommendation; this is a Layer 1B research universe expansion only.
